description_en: Modifies a material directory in a collaboration workspace
description_zh: 修改协作空间资料目录
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo update-group-directory --group-id group_example --directory-id dir_example --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateGroupDirectory

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If specified, the operation is executed as the user identified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The proxy user ID, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy user code, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If omitted, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the physical subdirectory in the current workspace. Internal root directories and referenced directories are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 当前空间物理子目录 ID，不允许内部根或引用目录
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The new name. If omitted or set to null, the name is not modified
parameters.help_zh: 新名称；省略或 null 不修改
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The new description. An empty string clears the description. If omitted or set to null, the description is not modified. At least one of the name or description parameters must be non-null
parameters.help_zh: 新描述；空字符串清空，省略或 null 不修改；name/description 至少一个非 null
parameters.name: description

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

directoryType.description_en: The directory type. The value is fixed as GROUP

groupId.description_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace

kbRootDirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the internal root directory in the collaboration workspace. This directory cannot be modified
kbRootDirectoryId.description_zh: 协作空间内部根目录 ID，不允许修改

parentDirectoryId.description_en: The ID of the parent directory
